thread:
omar_cs: Quick flag — Zephyr's dedicated pool (zephyr-ded-2) showed sustained saturation early this morning. GPU hours ~4x baseline and queue depth stayed high for ~90m. Can infra/sre advise?

capacity-bot: Auto-report: pool=zephyr-ded-2, window=02:10-04:00 UTC, avg_gpu_hours=28.4 (baseline 7.1), peak_queue_depth=46, 95p_latency_tokens=340ms -> 1120ms, error_rate(5m)=4.1% (mainly 429s). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/zephyr/pool-health

yuki_infra: digging in. initial trace: many short-lived sessions from onboarding harness + frequent model reloads -> KV misses. No single heavy job. Looks like they ramped parallelism for a demo.

trent_sre: 429s are our request-queue throttle. Autoscaler added nodes but they timed out due to short jobs. Recommending: small per-tenant concurrency cap + temporary reservation of 1 dedicated slot for their demo traffic.

claire_am: they have a partner demo at 09:00 PDT today. if the experience is poor, churn risk could increase. I'll tell them we are investigating and will mitigate.

omar_cs: proposed immediate steps: 1) apply 2h soft concurrency cap, 2) reserve 1 slot for demo if available, 3) recommend KV prefill and lower parallelism to customer, 4) finance watch for burst charges. ok?

yuki_infra: can apply cap now: `redwoodctl capacity update --tenant zephyr --concurrency 5 --window 2h --note "mitigate onboarding burst"` executing in 1m.

```
# run by infra
redwoodctl capacity update --tenant zephyr --concurrency 5 --window 2h --note "mitigate onboarding burst"
```

trent_sre: I'll attempt to reserve 1 slot: `redwoodctl slot reserve --pool zephyr-ded-2 --count 1 --duration 2h --reason "partner demo"` will report back. Also switching autoscale to `zephyr-onboard-safe` for 2h.

billing-bot: Billing alert triggered: tenant=zephyr, est_overage=$1.5k -> notification sent to finance@redwood at 1733333450.

capacity-bot: Actions: concurrency cap applied by yuki_infra at 1733333385. Autoscale policy set to zephyr-onboard-safe by trent_sre at 1733333420. Slot reserve attempted at 1733333430: result=success.

claire_am: Thanks — I'll message Zephyr: "We've applied a temporary cap and reserved capacity for your demo. We'll share a short checklist to avoid spikes." Can someone draft 4 bullets?

omar_cs: Draft bullets: 1) limit parallel demo workers to 4-6, 2) prefill KV cache with `prefill_cache=true` before demo, 3) use small batch sizes for interactive demos, 4) monitor token limits / avoid full-model reloads between requests.

yuki_infra: metrics 20m after cap: peak_queue_depth -> 12, 95p_latency_tokens -> 430ms, error_rate -> 0.7%. Holding but will watch for TTL/KV misses.

trent_sre: created ticket https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-9155 "Zephyr dedicated pool onboarding saturation" assigned to yuki_infra, priority P2.

omar_cs: summary: - cap applied (yuki) - reserved 1 slot for demo (trent) - autoscale safe policy set (trent) - ticket CS-9155 opened (yuki) - finance alerted (billing-bot) - customer notified (claire). check back in 40m. :white_check_mark:

yuki_infra: 40m update -> stable, queue 6-10, 95p ~380-440ms, errors ~0.4%. will keep cap until window expires and follow up in CS-9155.

claire_am: Great work team — I'll run the checklist with Zephyr and follow up to avoid repeated spikes.

omar_cs: closing thread for now, follow-ups in CS-9155."
